assumptions: Consumes caller-supplied planet/environment model cues and stable planet/location identities read-only.
limitations: Generated relief is not canonical elevation or surveyed topography.
Tectonic, volcanic, impact, erosion, drainage, lake, wetland, coastline and substrate outputs are bounded model cues, not measured physical truth.

fidelity.validity: Supported solid, oceanic, airless, icy and arid surface presentation contexts; giant no-surface states fail closed
fidelity.resolution: Continuous spherical field plus bounded local drainage probes and traces
fidelity.uncertainty: Heuristic model-derived morphology; exact plate histories, measured elevations, physical flow rates and canonical watershed boundaries are not claimed

assumptions: Selected planet, canonical identity, selection, temporal history and parent commitment are supplied by their existing authorities.
limitations: Surface location and patch identities are deterministic derived addresses, not replacement canonical geodesy or selection authority.
PX context refinement does not promote presentation terrain into physical truth.

fidelity.validity: Supported normalized microdegree latitude/longitude and cube-sphere LOD addresses
fidelity.resolution: LOD 0 through 20 with LOD-independent normalized location identity
fidelity.uncertainty: Address mapping is mathematical/derived; it is not a terrain or camera measurement

assumptions: Consumes V2X-06 model-derived surface geography/hydrology and caller-owned surface location context read-only.
limitations: Grid heights, coast lines, river paths, substrate hooks and LOD patch boundaries are presentation representations.
No central renderer, camera, selection, persistence or event-admission authority is owned by this provider.

fidelity.resolution: Odd-grid cube-sphere patches with deterministic shared spherical edge samples and adaptive patch working set
fidelity.uncertainty: Visual morphology is model/presentation-derived and not canonical elevation

assumptions: Consumes a bounded hierarchical terrain materialization and emits Canvas2D/SVG presentation only.
limitations: SVG/Canvas output is not scientific measurement or GPU certification.
Integration into the convergence-owned central renderer router is not performed by this lane.

fidelity.validity: Regional/local model-derived terrain frames and explicit no-solid-surface states
fidelity.resolution: Bounded patch mosaics with terrain cells, coastline cues and river polylines
fidelity.uncertainty: Rendered scale, colors, coastlines and flow paths are presentation cues
